knimeNode.name: Spark Number to String(Obzen)
knimeNode.shortDescription: Converts numeric columns to String type in a Spark DataFrame.

intro.p: Converts selected numeric columns (Integer, Long, Double) in a Spark DataFrame to String type. Null values remain null in the output.

tab.name: Column Selection
tab.option: Select the numeric columns to convert to String. Only numeric-type columns from the input Spark DataFrame are shown.

ports.inPort: Spark DataFrame containing numeric columns to convert.
ports.outPort: Spark DataFrame with selected columns converted to String type.
